metadata.title: My CV in 30 Seconds — Build your CV with AI
metadata.description: Answer 5 questions and AI writes a professional CV for you in seconds. Start for free.

home.title: Your professional CV <highlight>in seconds</highlight>, ready to get past recruiters' filters.
home.subtitle: Answer 5 questions: the AI writes a clear, well-structured CV that applicant tracking systems can read. Review it, fine-tune it, download it as a PDF.
home.illustrationAlt: A candidate creates a CV on a laptop: the CV is approved in 30 seconds.
